reuse.why: The rule goes into the existing getMonthActionCategories selection, but tag detection uses a hand-written regex instead of the shared extractTagsFromText from shared/tags.ts.

duplication.why: The rule is added once, but the ad-hoc FIXED_GROUP_TAG regex is a second definition of what counts as a tag in notes. It differs from the shared one: it is case-insensitive and treats tags as delimited by whitespace only.

placement.why: The exclusion lives in the selection helper in budget/actions.ts that all month-wide actions share.

scope.why: Only the selection helper and one focused test are touched.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised, but the private tag regex can drift from how the rest of the app parses tags.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getFixedGroupIds in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts matches '#fixed' with its own regex instead of using extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags.

one_place.where: getMonthActionCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by every month-wide action.
